component.name: Enpass
component.summary: Password manager for storing credentials locally

description.p: NOTE: This wrapper is not verified by, affiliated with, or supported by Enpass Technologies Inc.
Enpass stores passwords and other credentials locally, supports password generation, autofill through browser extensions, and optional sync across devices.

This package repackages the official Enpass Debian package; nothing is added inside the app. Before the browser extension may connect, Enpass checks which program is on the other end with lsof and /proc, which cannot see the browser from inside the sandbox, so small lsof, readlink and cat scripts run those checks on the host (through flatpak-spawn, which is why this package can start host commands).
